title: Nebensätze mit weil
summary: Using 'weil' where the conjugated verb moves to the end of the subclause.
explanation: Using 'weil' where the conjugated verb moves to the end of the subclause.

example_translations.ex_de_a2: Ich lerne Deutsch, weil es wichtig ist.

common_error_explanations.err_de_a2: In subordinate clauses introduced by 'weil', the conjugated verb must be placed at the end.
